restart_required.title: Restart required

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Home Assistant will restart immediately so that Solar Cube can finish its installation. Any unsaved changes in other browser tabs will be lost.

restart_required.description: Restart of Home Assistant is required to finish download/update of {integration}. Click submit to restart now. After the restart, hard-refresh your browser (Ctrl+F5 or Cmd+Shift+R) to load the updated frontend resources.

lcd_bridge_problem.title: Solar Cube LCD display unavailable
lcd_bridge_problem.description:
The Solar Cube PRO S1 LCD display is enabled, but the Solar LCD Bridge at {url} cannot be used: {reason}.

The rest of the integration is unaffected. Fix the bridge configuration, or turn off **Enable Solar Cube PRO S1 LCD display** in the integration options. This message clears automatically once a frame is accepted.

dashboards_outdated.title: Solar Cube dashboards are out of date
dashboards_outdated.description:
A newer version of {dashboards} ships with this update, but your copy has been edited so it was left untouched.

To take the new version and discard your edits, go to Settings → Devices & Services → Solar Cube → Configure and tick **Re-apply shipped dashboards**.
